description_en: Queries the triggers of an application by application name
description_zh: 根据应用名称查询该应用的触发器
kebab_example: aliyun cs get-kubernetes-trigger --cluster-id c5cdf7e3938bc4f8eb0e44b21a80f0000 --namespace default --name web-server --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetKubernetesTrigger

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type. Valid values:

`deployment`: a trigger for a stateless application. 

`application`: a trigger for an application center application.

Default value: `deployment`.

If you do not specify a trigger type, the query results are not filtered by trigger type
parameters.help_zh:
触发器类型。取值：

`deployment`：针对无状态应用的触发器。 

`application`：针对应用中心应用的触发器。

默认值：`deployment`。

当不指定触发器类型时，查询结果将不过滤触发器类型
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The trigger action. Valid values:

`redeploy`: redeploys the resources defined in `project_id`.

If you do not specify a trigger action, the query results are not filtered by trigger action
parameters.help_zh:
触发器行为，取值：

`redeploy`：重新部署`project_id`中定义的资源。

当不指定触发器行为时，查询结果将不过滤触发器行为
parameters.name: action

schema.description_en: The list of trigger query result details
schema.description_zh: 触发器查询结果详情列表

action.description_en:
The trigger action. Valid values:

`redeploy`: redeploys the resources defined in project_id
action.description_zh:
触发器行为，取值：

`redeploy`: 重新部署project_id中定义的资源

project_id.description_en:
The trigger project name.

The value consists of the namespace and application name in the format of `${namespace}/${name}`. Example: default/test-app
project_id.description_zh:
触发器项目名称。

由应用所在命名空间及应用名称组成，格式为`${namespace}/${name}`，取值示例：default/test-app

type.description_en:
The trigger type.

Valid values:

`deployment`: a trigger for a stateless application. 

`application`: a trigger for an application center application.

Default value: `deployment`
type.description_zh:
触发器类型。

取值：

`deployment`：针对无状态应用的触发器。 

`application`：针对应用中心应用的触发器。

默认值：`deployment`
